## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(vars)
library(tseries)
library(urca)
library(ggthemes)
library(car)
library(fixest)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
# Read and process data
data <- read_csv("data/master.csv")
data$gdp <- data$gdp / 1e6
data$export <- data$export / 1e6
data$import <- data$import / 1e6
data$country <- as.factor(data$country)
data$year <- as.factor(data$year)
```

```{r}
# Baseline models
ex_model <- feols(export ~ inward_fdi + gdp + unemployment_rate + population + industry + econ_freedom | csw(country, year), data = data, vcov = "hetero")
im_model <- feols(import ~ inward_fdi + gdp + unemployment_rate + population + industry + econ_freedom | csw(country, year), data = data, vcov = "hetero")
etable(ex_model, im_model, vcov = "hetero")
```

```{r}
# Models with interaction term
int_ex_model <- feols(export ~ inward_fdi * gdp + unemployment_rate + population + industry + econ_freedom | csw(country, year), data = data, vcov = "hetero")
int_im_model <- feols(import ~ inward_fdi * gdp + unemployment_rate + population + industry + econ_freedom | csw(country, year), data = data, vcov = "hetero")
etable(int_ex_model, int_im_model, vcov = "hetero")
```

```{r}
# If you want to check p-values of any models, use summary()
summary(int_ex_model)
```

```{r}
# correlation matrix
cor(x = data[, c(3,6,7,8,9,10)], use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}
# Creating Q-Q plots
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

qqnorm(resid(ex_model), main = "Export Model")
qqline(resid(ex_model))

qqnorm(resid(im_model), main = "Import Model")
qqline(resid(im_model))

qqnorm(resid(int_ex_model), main = "Interaction Export Model")
qqline(resid(int_ex_model))

qqnorm(resid(int_im_model), main = "Interaction Import Model")
qqline(resid(int_im_model))

# Reset plotting layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
